verdict.rationale: Pilot markets that switching providers is supported and mentions keeping existing QuickBooks account and historical data, implying migration support, but there's no detail on how historical transaction-level detail is preserved or migrated from other systems (e.g., Xero, Wave, spreadsheets) beyond QuickBooks. missing for 10: documented migration process, evidence of no data/detail loss, support for non-QuickBooks source systems, independent confirmation of successful migrations.
